units.source_text: 汽车在满目嫩叶的市街奔驰。

en.t: Cars sped through the city streets, which were filled everywhere with fresh green leaves.

units.source_text: 古色古香的房子，看上去要比新建的楼房更能衬托出嫩叶的勃勃生机。

en.t: The old-fashioned houses seemed to bring out the vibrant life of the young leaves even more than the newly built buildings did.
